name: Famine
value: Risk of Famine: Sudan, South Sudan, Somalia
summary: FEWS NET assesses risk of Famine in Sudan, South Sudan and Somalia; no area classified as Famine as of 12 Nov
state: FEWS NET's latest Sudan update, covering September 2026 to January 2027, says the risk of Famine has spread to parts of South Darfur and persists in North Darfur and around Kadugli and Dilling, but its camp findings do not establish a Famine (IPC Phase 5) classification. FEWS NET also assesses a credible risk of Famine in southern Somalia from October 2026 to January 2027 (Dawan, 7 Oct). Searches on 12 Nov found no area newly classified as Famine.
for_you: Most directly affects people in besieged or cut-off areas of Darfur and Kordofan, South Sudan and southern Somalia. Further deterioration tends to bring more displacement and higher child malnutrition; WFP and WHO publish updates.
rubric_hit: Watch: FEWS NET risk-of-Famine alerts for Sudan, South Sudan and Somalia; no IPC Phase 5 Famine classification (Alert line)

sources.title: FEWS NET — Sudan: as drought compounds conflict, the risk of Famine expands to parts of South Darfur
Dawan Africa — Southern Somalia faces credible risk of famine through January, FEWS NET warns

why: Famine is the most extreme humanitarian failure, almost always man-made by conflict.
drivers: War, sieges, aid access, harvest failure, funding cuts.

rubric.alert: Famine (IPC Phase 5) confirmed in at least one area.
rubric.watch: IPC Phase 5 projected or 'risk of famine' alerts.
rubric.normal: No IPC Phase 5 (Famine) classifications or projections.
